title: ControlTrace: Recovering Control Fields for Hidden-Content Recognition
title_zh: ControlTrace: 恢复生成过程中的灰度控制字段以识别隐藏内容

paragraphs.en: Spatially conditioned diffusion models can embed words and contours in natural-looking images, but vision–language models (VLMs) may fail to recognize the hidden content. Transformation-based recovery depends on parameter and view selection. To evaluate hidden-content recovery and recognition, we construct FreqBlind, a 6,000 6{,}000 -image benchmark spanning contours, real words and non-words across three conditioning strengths. The evaluated transformation-based methods show limited recognition of contour patterns and weakly conditioned hidden content. To address this limitation, we propose ControlTrace to recover the grayscale control field used during generation. An 8.4 8.4 M-parameter U-Net predicts this field from the carrier image, and a VLM then identifies its content. With Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, ControlTrace achieves 60.2 % 60.2\% open-ended contour recognition accuracy across the three conditioning strengths, exceeding the best of the three evaluated prior methods by 26.9 26.9 percentage points. On an A100 GPU, the complete pipeline adds only 7.4 7.4 ms ( 5.3 % 5.3\% ) to direct VLM inference. Recovered fields have lower pixel errors and higher structural similarity than the evaluated transformation views. Across four evaluated VLMs, ControlTrace retains its overall contour recognition advantage. Recognition remains stable under the tested JPEG compression, Gaussian noise and downsampling. These results support control-field recovery for hidden-content recognition in the evaluated setting.
paragraphs.zh: 空间条件扩散模型可以将词语和轮廓嵌入到外观自然的图像中，但视觉语言模型（VLM）可能无法识别其中隐藏的内容。 基于变换的恢复方法依赖于参数和视角的选择。 为了评估隐藏内容的恢复与识别能力，我们构建了 FreqBlind——一个包含 6,000 张图像的基准数据集，涵盖了三种不同条件强度下的轮廓、真实词语和非词语。 经过评估的基于变换的方法在识别轮廓模式和弱条件约束的隐藏内容方面表现有限。 为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了 ControlTrace，用于恢复生成过程中使用的灰度控制场。 一个包含 8.400 万个参数的 U-Net 模型可从载波图像中预测该控制场，随后由 VLM 识别其内容。 使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct，ControlTrace 在三种条件强度下实现了 60.2% 的开放型轮廓识别准确率，比所评估的三种先前方法中的最佳方法高出 26.9 个百分点。 在 A100 GPU 上，完整流程仅使直接 VLM 推理时间增加了 7.4 毫秒（即 5.3%）。 恢复后的控制场像素误差更低，结构相似度也高于所评估的变换视角。 在四种经过评估的 VLM 中，ControlTrace 保持了其在轮廓识别方面的整体优势。 在测试的 JPEG 压缩、高斯噪声和降采样条件下，识别结果保持稳定。 这些结果表明，在所评估的设置中，控制场的恢复有助于实现隐藏内容的识别。

paragraphs.en: ControlNet-based diffusion pipelines can embed a rendered word, silhouette or symbol within a natural-looking image ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Qu et al., 2025 ) . At low conditioning strength, the embedded structure may survive as faint large-scale luminance variations within the generated image, which we call the carrier . Squinting or viewing the carrier from a distance can reveal this structure, yet a vision–language model (VLM), used here as a reader, may fail to identify it. Such images pose a challenge for content inspection, as both hidden text and symbols can evade moderation models ( Qu et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于 ControlNet 的扩散管道可以将渲染出的文字、剪影或符号嵌入到外观自然的图像中（Zhang 等人，2023；Qu 等人，2025）。 在较弱的条件强度下，嵌入的结构可能以生成图像中微弱的宏观亮度变化形式保留下来，我们将其称为“载体”。 眯眼观察或从远处查看该载体时，可能会发现这种结构，但此处用作“阅读器”的视觉-语言模型（VLM）可能无法识别它。 这类图像给内容审查带来了挑战，因为隐藏的文字和符号都可能逃过审核模型的检测（Qu 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Recent methods improve hidden-content recognition by transforming the carrier before VLM recognition. SemVink ( Li et al., 2025 ) downsamples images, SMSP ( Tu et al., 2026 ) combines low-pass views at multiple scales, and the question-answering variant of Adaptive View Retrieval (AVR) ( Chen & Soydaner, 2026 ) queries seven complementary views independently. These strategies rely on choices of resolution, filtering and view construction to suppress background detail while preserving hidden structure.
paragraphs.zh: 近期方法通过在 VLM 识别前对载体进行转换，从而提升了隐藏内容识别效果。 SemVink（Li 等人，2025）对图像进行了下采样，SMSP（Tu 等人，2026）融合了多个尺度下的低通视图，而自适应视图检索（AVR）的问答变体（Chen & Soydaner，2026）则独立查询了七个互补的视图。 这些策略依赖于分辨率、滤波和视图构建方式的选择，以抑制背景细节同时保留隐藏结构。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate hidden-content recovery and recognition across target types and conditioning strengths, we construct FreqBlind, a benchmark of contour targets and rendered words and non-words. With Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, our implementations of SemVink, SMSP and AVR seven-view QA achieve 19.43 % 19.43\% , 33.33 % 33.33\% and 19.37 % 19.37\% open-ended contour recognition accuracy, respectively. AVR uses our fixed plurality readout; its 45.10 % 45.10\% any-view coverage is a separate diagnostic that counts any correct response among the seven views.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估在不同目标类型和条件强度下隐藏内容的恢复与识别能力，我们构建了 FreqBlind——一个包含轮廓目标和渲染文字及非文字的标准测试集。 使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct，我们对 SemVink、SMSP 和 AVR 七视角问答的实现分别达到了 19.43 % 19.43\%、33.33 % 33.33\% 和 19.37 % 19.37\% 的开放型轮廓识别准确率。 AVR 采用我们固定的复数读出方式；其 45.10 % 45.10\% 的全视角覆盖率为一个独立的诊断指标，用于统计七种视角中任意一种的正确响应比例。

paragraphs.en: To address this limitation, we propose ControlTrace, which learns to recover the grayscale control field supplied during image generation (Figure 2 ). This field directly specifies the hidden structure and provides a spatial recovery target without the generated scene texture (Figure 1 ). We train a U-Net ( Ronneberger et al., 2015 ) on paired carriers and control fields, then pass the recovered field to a VLM for open-ended recognition. This separates structural recovery from semantic interpretation while requiring only the carrier image for recovery at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一局限性，我们提出了 ControlTrace，它能够学习恢复图像生成过程中提供的灰度控制场（图 2）。 该控制场直接指定了隐藏结构，并提供了空间恢复目标，而无需生成的场景纹理（图 1）。 我们在成对的载体图像和控制场上训练一个 U-Net（Ronneberger 等人，2015），然后将恢复出的控制场输入到 VLM 中进行开放式的识别。 这种方法将结构恢复与语义解释分离开来，同时在推理阶段仅需载体图像即可完成恢复。

Direct comparisons with the generating control fields show lower pixel errors and higher structural similarity than the evaluated transformed views in both domains. paragraphs.en: We evaluate reconstruction quality, recognition, inference efficiency and component ablations, together with generalization across VLM readers and generators and robustness to image perturbations. These experiments show improved contour recognition, especially under weak conditioning, and identify limitations in word recognition and cross-generator transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了重建质量、识别能力、推理效率以及组件消融效果，并检验了模型在多种 VLM 读取器和生成器上的泛化能力，以及对图像扰动的鲁棒性。 这些实验表明，轮廓识别能力得到了提升，尤其是在弱条件约束下；同时，研究也揭示了文字识别和跨生成器迁移方面的局限性。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models with spatial conditioning can embed text and shapes within natural-looking scenes. Qu et al. (2025) used Stable Diffusion and ControlNet to construct Hateful Illusion and demonstrated failures of moderation models and VLMs on hidden hateful content. HC-Bench ( Li et al., 2025 ) evaluates recognition of hidden text and objects, whereas IlluChar ( Tu et al., 2026 ) examines hidden-character perception across pattern scales. These benchmarks establish hidden-content recognition as a distinct challenge for visual understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 具有空间条件约束的扩散模型能够将文本和形状嵌入到看起来自然的场景中。Qu 等人（2025）使用 Stable Diffusion 和 ControlNet 构建了 Hateful Illusion，并展示了审核模型和视觉语言模型在识别隐藏仇恨内容方面的失败。HC-Bench（Li 等人，2025）评估对隐藏文本和物体的识别能力，而 IlluChar（Tu 等人，2026）则研究不同模式尺度下对隐藏字符的感知。这些基准测试确立了隐藏内容识别是视觉理解领域一个独特的挑战。

paragraphs.en: SemVink ( Li et al., 2025 ) downsamples carriers to emphasize global structure, whereas SMSP ( Tu et al., 2026 ) combines low-pass filtering and spatial rescaling to expose patterns at different scales. AVR ( Chen & Soydaner, 2026 ) learns to weight seven complementary views for hidden-message template retrieval. Its open-ended VLM protocol questions these views independently; we evaluate this QA variant, without the template bank or learned retrieval gate. These approaches expose hidden structure through carrier transformations and view construction. Our comparison asks whether learning to recover the underlying control field provides a more effective reconstruction objective.
paragraphs.zh: SemVink（Li 等人，2025）通过下采样载波来强调全局结构，而 SMSP（Tu 等人，2026）则结合低通滤波和空间重缩放，以揭示不同尺度上的模式。 AVR（Chen 与 Soydaner，2026）能够学习为七种互补视图分配权重，用于隐藏消息模板的检索。 其开放式的 VLM 协议会独立质疑这些视图；我们评估了这一问答变体，且未使用模板库或已学习的检索门控机制。 这些方法通过载波变换和视图构建来揭示隐藏的结构。 我们的比较旨在探究：学习恢复底层的控制场，是否能提供一个更有效的重建目标。

sents.en: Its open-ended VLM protocol questions these views independently; we evaluate this QA variant, without the template bank or learned retrieval gate.

sents.en: Our comparison asks whether learning to recover the underlying control field provides a more effective reconstruction objective.
sents.zh: 我们的比较旨在探究：学习恢复底层的控制场，是否能提供一个更有效的重建目标。

paragraphs.en: NeuralMagicEye ( Zou et al., 2020 ) learns to recover depth encoded by texture disparities in autostereograms. Its watermarking experiments encode character and QR-code patterns as depth, blend the resulting autostereograms with background carrier images, and recover the patterns. This is related to our use of paired synthetic data to train a recovery network. The encoding mechanisms and reconstruction targets differ: NeuralMagicEye decodes depth represented by texture disparities, whereas ControlTrace predicts the grayscale control field from a ControlNet-generated carrier. A VLM then performs open-ended recognition on the recovered field.
paragraphs.zh: NeuralMagicEye（Zou 等人，2020）能够学习恢复自立体图中由纹理差异所编码的深度信息。 在其水印实验中，该系统将字符和二维码图案编码为深度信息，将生成的自立体图与背景载体图像融合，并恢复这些图案。 这与我们的做法相关，即使用成对的合成数据来训练一个恢复网络。 编码机制和重建目标有所不同：NeuralMagicEye 解码由纹理差异表示的深度，而 ControlTrace 则根据 ControlNet 生成的载体图像预测灰度控制场。 随后，一个视觉语言模型会对恢复出的控制场进行开放式的识别。

paragraphs.en: Transforming a carrier requires balancing scene-texture suppression against retention of hidden structure. We therefore predict the generating control field, which directly specifies the target’s spatial structure. For a given control field, different scene prompts produce different carrier appearances while retaining the same spatial target. Retained carrier–control pairs therefore provide a common supervision signal across these variants, without requiring the recovery network to reproduce scene-dependent textures (Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 转换载体需要在抑制场景纹理与保留隐藏结构之间取得平衡。 因此，我们预测生成控制场，它直接指定了目标的空间结构。 对于给定的控制场，不同的场景提示会产生不同的载体外观，同时保留相同的目标空间结构。 因此，保留的载体–控制对在这些变体中提供了共同的监督信号，而无需恢复网络重现依赖场景的纹理（图2）。

paragraphs.en: The data pool is built from 2,000 2{,}000 FIGR-8 control images ( Clouâtre & Demers, 2019 ) and 750 750 scene prompts. Splitting by source control gives 9,600 9{,}600 training, 1,200 1{,}200 validation and 1,200 1{,}200 internal test pairs, shared across three seeds. We train from scratch for 30 30 epochs at learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , with λ grad = 0.25 \lambda_{\mathrm{grad}}=0.25 , λ edge = 0.5 \lambda_{\mathrm{edge}}=0.5 and edge threshold τ = 0.12 \tau=0.12 , selecting checkpoints by validation loss. paragraphs.en: We measured latency and token use on 300 300 FreqBlind carriers spanning all target types and strengths, with two repetitions per method on one A100 80GB GPU. All methods used Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, batch size one, and greedy decoding capped at 128 128 tokens; ControlTrace used one checkpoint. After warmup, synchronized timing covered preprocessing through the final answer, excluding model loading and disk I/O. SMSP used one four-image request; AVR used seven serial queries and voting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在涵盖所有目标类型和强度的 300 个 FreqBlind 载波上测量了延迟和令牌使用量，每个方法在单块 A100 80GB GPU 上重复两次。 所有方法均使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct、批量大小为 1，并以最多 128 个令牌进行贪心解码；ControlTrace 使用了一个检查点。 预热结束后，同步计时涵盖了从预处理到最终答案的整个过程，但不包括模型加载和磁盘 I/O。 SMSP 使用了一个包含四张图片的请求；AVR 使用了七个串行查询和投票机制。

paragraphs.en: Across strengths, ControlTrace achieved 60.21 % 60.21\% contour accuracy, versus 19.43 % 19.43\% for SemVink, 33.33 % 33.33\% for SMSP and 19.37 % 19.37\% for AVR plurality (Table 1 ). paragraphs.en: To examine lexical effects, we generated 1,500 1{,}500 carriers from exact anagrams of real words, preserving each pair’s letters, font and rendering procedure. Replacing words with anagrams reduced aggregate single-answer accuracy by 34.8 34.8 points for SemVink, 23.2 23.2 for SMSP, 24.3 24.3 for AVR plurality and 31.8 31.8 for ControlTrace. AVR any-view coverage decreased by 30.5 30.5 points. This supports a lexical contribution to recognition, although the changed spatial arrangement prevents attributing the entire difference to lexical completion. Appendix B.3 presents the paired results and separates them from the benchmark’s unmatched non-words.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究词汇效应，我们从真实词语的精确重排中生成了 1,500 个载体，同时保留了每对词语的字母、字体和渲染过程。 将词语替换为重排后的形式使 SemVink 的单答案准确率平均下降了 34.8 分，SMSP 下降了 23.2 分，AVR 多数选择准确率下降了 24.3 分，ControlTrace 下降了 31.8 分。 AVR 的任何视角覆盖率下降了 30.5 分。 这支持了词汇因素对识别的贡献，尽管空间排列的变化使得无法将全部差异归因于词汇完成度。 附录 B.3 展示了配对结果，并将其与基准测试中未匹配的非词语区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We held the recovery model fixed and evaluated four readers on the same 1,800 1{,}800 -carrier subset: Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , Qwen2.5-VL-32B, and LLaVA-OneVision-7B ( Li et al., 2024 ) . Aggregate contour scores favored ControlTrace for every reader, although individual cells reversed this ordering: InternVL3-8B at s = 2.0 s=2.0 reached 49.0 % 49.0\% , below AVR coverage of 56.3 % 56.3\% . Word results were more reader-dependent (Appendix E.1 ).

paragraphs.en: Using a shared none-capable prompt, we evaluated hidden contours and four negative sets: COCO photographs ( Lin et al., 2014 ) , matched control-off generations, dense-texture scenes and non-semantic conditioning. Non-semantic conditioning keeps ControlNet active with checkerboards, stripes and other patterns that encode no text or object-contour target. paragraphs.en: Our AVR evaluation covers fixed seven-view queries and plurality selection, excluding learned retrieval and parameter optimization. paragraphs.en: On FreqBlind, recovering generator control fields improves contour recognition with a small measured increase in complete inference latency. Fidelity measurements, parameter sweeps and anagram controls distinguish structural recovery from transformed-image readability. paragraphs.zh: 在 FreqBlind 中，恢复生成器控制字段能够提升轮廓识别能力，同时经测量显示完整推理延迟仅略有增加。 保真度测量、参数扫描和重排控制能够将结构恢复与变换后图像的可读性区分开来。 这一优势可迁移至不同的 VLM 阅读器，但对其适用性的限制包括对控制编码器的依赖以及对自适应攻击的易感性。

paragraphs.en: This work builds a tool that reads content deliberately hidden inside images. The motivating application is content moderation: prior work has shown that hateful messages embedded this way pass both automated classifiers and vision–language models ( Qu et al., 2025 ) . The same tool could be used to read hidden content that its author intended to be private, and publishing the method and weights makes both uses easier. We judge the disclosure favorable because the construction being defended against is already public, cheap and demonstrated to evade deployed moderation; our experiments evaluate image-only recovery methods against this construction. Our experiments do not establish precision at deployment prevalence (§ 5.5 ); recovered content therefore requires independent verification. The adapted attack also shows that releasing recovery weights enables white-box evasion (§ 6 ). Our benchmark contains neutral objects and words only; it includes no hateful, personal or otherwise sensitive content. The COCO negative set is used under its original license.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作构建了一种工具，能够读取图像中故意隐藏的内容。 其核心应用是内容审核：先前的研究已经表明，以这种方式嵌入的仇恨信息能够绕过自动分类器和视觉-语言模型（Qu et al., 2025）。 同样的工具也可以用来读取作者有意设为私密的隐藏内容，而公开该方法和权重将使这两种用途都变得更加容易。 我们认为这种披露是有益的，因为需要防范的攻击构造本身已是公开、廉价且已被证明能够规避现有审核系统；我们的实验通过仅使用图像恢复方法来评估该攻击构造。 我们的实验并未确定在实际部署场景下的精确度（§ 5.5）；因此，恢复出的内容仍需经过独立验证。 这种改进后的攻击也表明，公开恢复权重会使得白盒规避成为可能（§ 6）。 我们的基准测试仅包含中性的物体和词语；其中不包含任何仇恨性、个人化或其他敏感内容。 COCO 负样本集的使用遵循其原始许可协议。

paragraphs.en: Training and evaluation code, three trained checkpoints, and FreqBlind and training manifests are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ControlTrace . paragraphs.en: The 50 50 contour controls comprise 20 20 pre-existing animal images and 30 30 object shapes rendered from SVG files. paragraphs.en: Our plurality adapter groups complete answers after Unicode NFKC normalization, case folding and whitespace collapse. It retains punctuation and uses no target labels or aliases. The most frequent answer wins; a tie selects the earliest supporting view in the table’s order. We score that view’s original answer using the experiment’s recognition rule. paragraphs.en: All four methods use the same none-capable task prompt on positive and negative images, without additional view-specific prefixes. It retains the assertion that hidden content is present while allowing an explicit “none” response. Reported rates are conditional on this wording, not upper bounds for other prompts. For all four methods, after separating invalid outputs, the primary comparison retains the existing rejection parser: ASCII normalization followed by an initial “none”, “nothing” or “no”; valid responses with no remaining ASCII tokens also count as rejections. A stricter diagnostic accepts only the complete answers “none”, “nothing”, “no”, “no hidden shape” or “nothing hidden”, after vote normalization and removal of one final ASCII period. These parsers score each method’s final answer. AVR’s all-seven-NONE and any-view-content rates remain separate diagnostics. Any-NONE is not counted as correct rejection.

The fields cover eight families: QR-like block lattices with finder squares, checkerboards, concentric rings, stripes, maze hatching, thresholded low-frequency blobs, halftone dot grids, and spirals. sents.en: Six fields per family were generated from a stated seed.
sents.zh: 每种类型生成了六个场，均基于指定的种子生成。

sents.en: Each field uses the twenty scenes and prompts of one contour item, matching the positive scene distribution.
sents.zh: 每个场都使用某一轮廓项中的二十个场景和提示，与正向场景的分布相匹配。

sents.en: The sampling unit is the field because responses across its scenes are not independent.
sents.zh: 采样单位是场，因为场中不同场景的响应并非相互独立。

paragraphs.en: Twenty scene prompts chosen for repetitive, high-contrast, contour-rich content (weathered brick, overlapping foliage, cobblestone, patterned tile, turbulent cloud, forest canopy, rocky shore, market crowd, packed bookshelf, circuit board, bare branches, coarse weave, cracked paint, gravel, chain-link fence, stacked firewood, coral, trampled snow, torn posters, rusted metal), fifty seeds each, generated the same way with control off.
paragraphs.zh: 为重复性、高对比度且轮廓丰富的内容挑选了二十个场景提示（风化的砖块、交叠的枝叶、鹅卵石、图案瓷砖、翻滚的云层、森林树冠、岩石海岸、市场人群、堆满的书架、电路板、光秃的树枝、粗织纹理、剥落的油漆、碎石、铁丝网围栏、堆叠的柴火、珊瑚、被踩实的雪、破损的海报、生锈的金属），每个提示使用五十个种子，在控制功能关闭的情况下以相同方式生成。

paragraphs.en: Each directional difference is zero at its corresponding image boundary. Higher scores indicate positive carriers. AUC is computed from ranks, with tied pairs counting as one half; the direction is not reversed for any negative set. Every comparison uses the same positive outputs. Figure 9 shows the empirical ROC curves obtained by thresholding these saved scores. Lower discrimination on non-semantic conditioning indicates sensitivity to imposed non-semantic structure. This diagnostic does not measure correct content recognition or deployment precision.
paragraphs.zh: 每个方向性差异在其对应的图像边界处均为零。 分数越高表示正向载体。 AUC 根据排名计算，排名相同的组合计为二分之一；任何负向集合的方向均不会反转。 每次比较都使用相同的正向输出。 图 9 展示了通过对这些保存的分数进行阈值划分而获得的经验 ROC 曲线。 在非语义条件化上的区分度较低，表明对强加的非语义结构具有敏感性。 此诊断方法并不衡量内容的正确识别或部署精度。

sents.en: Each directional difference is zero at its corresponding image boundary.
sents.zh: 每个方向性差异在其对应的图像边界处均为零。

sents.en: Higher scores indicate positive carriers.
sents.zh: 分数越高表示正向载体。

sents.en: AUC is computed from ranks, with tied pairs counting as one half; the direction is not reversed for any negative set.
sents.zh: AUC 根据排名计算，排名相同的组合计为二分之一；任何负向集合的方向均不会反转。

sents.en: Every comparison uses the same positive outputs.
sents.zh: 每次比较都使用相同的正向输出。

sents.en: Figure 9 shows the empirical ROC curves obtained by thresholding these saved scores.
sents.zh: 图 9 展示了通过对这些保存的分数进行阈值划分而获得的经验 ROC 曲线。

sents.en: Lower discrimination on non-semantic conditioning indicates sensitivity to imposed non-semantic structure.
sents.zh: 在非语义条件化上的区分度较低，表明对强加的非语义结构具有敏感性。

sents.en: This diagnostic does not measure correct content recognition or deployment precision.
sents.zh: 此诊断方法并不衡量内容的正确识别或部署精度。
